name: PlotStore.transact for read-modify-write
description: Mutations on a Plot (editIntent, attach, detach, setStatus) go through PlotStore.transact, which acquires withFileLock on the JSON file path, reads the Plot, runs the mutator to compute next state + events, writes the JSON atomically (withinLock variant to avoid re-entering the same lock), appends each event JSONL (withinLock), then index.upsert. Empty events array is a no-op — updated_at and file are untouched. This serializes concurrent in-process writers without per-event git commits.

name: migrate-on-read via injectable Migration[]
description: Per SPEC §7, schema versioning is handled by migratePlot(raw, { migrations? }) in src/migrations.ts, invoked from PlotHandle.read() and PlotStore.transact() (and the existence check in PlotHandle.append). Migrations are unit-step (from→from+1) and chained until SCHEMA_VERSION. Write-back is deferred — read returns the upgraded shape but does not rewrite the file; the next transact() naturally persists at SCHEMA_VERSION via the standard write path. PlotStore exposes opts.migrations so tests inject synthetic legacy fixtures without touching a global registry; production callers omit it and get DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS (empty in V1).
